items.name: Instant Itching Powder
items.description: A small sachet of fine powder. Application is instantaneous. Results are immediate and deeply personal.

items.name: Exploding Gift Wrap
items.description: Looks like perfectly normal gift wrap. Gives a modest pop when opened. Recipient reaction varies.

items.name: Embarrassing Sound Emitter
items.description: A small disc that activates on proximity. The sound it makes is difficult to describe and impossible to explain.

items.name: Misfortune Cookie
items.description: Looks like a fortune cookie. The message inside is accurate, specific, and not what anyone needed to hear today.

items.name: Reversing Ink
items.description: Write something. Wait 24 hours. Read it backwards. It will have changed. Not improved. Changed.

items.name: Instant Ramen (Actually Good)
items.description: It tastes exactly like the ramen you had that one night that fixed everything. Every time.

items.name: One-Time Knee Fix
items.description: Works once. Works completely. Do not ask about the second knee.

items.name: Forget Your Ex Soap
items.description: A bar of soap. Lathers completely normally. What were you thinking about? Exactly.

items.name: Five More Minutes Pillow
items.description: Grants exactly five more minutes of sleep. Resets alarm. Does not care about your meeting.

items.name: Adequate Day Tonic
items.description: Does not promise a good day. Promises an adequate one. For some people this is the miracle.

items.name: Elixir of Plausible Deniability
items.description: A single vial. Works exactly as described. You were never here. Neither was this.

items.name: Enchanted Baking Flour
items.description: Bakes normally. What comes out is slightly better than you deserve. Every time.

items.name: Ritual Candles (Unscented)
items.description: For rituals requiring candles. No scent. No questions. Twelve in a box.

items.name: Charm Components (Assorted)
items.description: A small pouch of miscellaneous charm components. Contents vary. Efficacy varies. Price does not.

items.name: Single-Use Luck Crystal
items.description: Use it once. Something good will happen. It will not be the thing you used it for.

items.name: Binding Thread (Gold)
items.description: Binds things together. Magically. What things is entirely up to you and entirely your responsibility.

items.name: Enchanted Ledger
items.description: Records everything that happens near it. Accurately. Permanently. Cannot be erased. Cannot be sold to the wrong person fast enough.

items.name: Loyalty Candle
items.description: Burns for exactly as long as the relationship it was lit for. This is sometimes 30 years. This is sometimes 40 minutes.

items.name: Self-Stirring Spoon
items.description: Stirs. Continuously. Has opinions about pace. Will not be rushed.

items.name: Anti-Gravity Gravy Boat
items.description: The gravy stays in the boat regardless of angle. This sounds small. It is not small.

items.name: Always-Right Clock (Bad News)
items.description: Always shows the correct time. This is not always good news. Cannot be stopped. Cannot be covered.

items.name: Self-Filing Paperwork
items.description: Files itself. Correctly. In the right place. The first time. Tax professionals have wept.

items.name: Perpetually Warm Coffee Mug
items.description: The coffee stays exactly the temperature you wanted it. Not hot. The temperature you wanted it.

items.name: Broom That Judges You
items.description: Sweeps the floor. Pauses. Looks at you. Sweeps again. You know what it's thinking.

items.name: Socks That Argue Politics
items.description: Warm. Comfortable. Hold strong opinions on several local issues. Will not let it go at dinner.

items.name: Key to Your Insecurities
items.description: A key. Opens one door. The door it opens is different for everyone. No refunds.

items.name: Mirror That Gives Honest Feedback
items.description: Reflects accurately. Also provides one unsolicited observation per morning. It is always right. You will hate it.

items.name: Plant That Knows Too Much
items.description: A small potted plant. Does not speak. Somehow you know it knows. It has been watching.

items.name: Probably Harmless Orb
items.description: Glows faintly. Warm to the touch. Bizard is 94% sure it is harmless. Will not specify what the 6% is.

items.name: Compliment Mirror
items.description: Says something nice every morning. Lies completely. You will check it anyway.

items.name: Strongly Worded Letter
items.description: Pre-written. Surprisingly effective. The recipient does not know why they feel compelled to comply. Neither do you.

items.name: Dungeon-Adjacent Gear
items.description: Not a weapon. Not armor. Something adjacent to both that covers the gap. Surprisingly useful down there.

items.name: Portable Door Alarm
items.description: Attaches to any door. Activates when opened without permission. Definition of permission is yours to set.

items.name: Emergency Rope (Judicious Use Only)
items.description: A coil of rope. Works for climbing, binding, and three other uses Bizard would prefer not to specify.

items.name: Silence Stone
items.description: Creates a small field of absolute silence when squeezed. Lasts 30 seconds. No exceptions. No carry-over.

items.name: Accountability Journal
items.description: Writes in itself. Records your intentions each morning. Compares them to your actions each evening. Diplomatically.
